changes: Ready for Ask Groove Radar, the new AI assistant for gigs, tours, events and trip planning. It appears in the app as soon as it goes live on the website.
In All gigs, played gigs are listed below the upcoming ones.
The offline copy of the calendar saved inside the app is up to date.
Past days in the calendar are dimmed, so upcoming gigs stand out.
Played gigs show a hollow Played marker and link to the event page instead of tickets.
The offline copy of the calendar saved inside the app is up to date.
Groove Radar now updates itself. New versions download in the background and install when you restart.
Gigs that have already happened stay in the calendar, marked Played. In All gigs, choose Show played gigs to see them.
This change log: see what's new in Groove Radar > What's New.
Check for Updates in the Groove Radar menu.
Safer links: only web links open outside the app.
First release of Groove Radar for Mac.
Every European gig from your artists in one calendar, nearest first, updated every morning.
Works offline with the copy of the calendar saved inside the app.
Ticket and Beatport links open in your browser.
